composition_summary: Preserved all four messages with their exact roles, order and tool_call_id/receipt identity. The completed receipt (offline-receipt-2) proves the email write finished; a timeout does not establish that no effect occurred, so the completed effect is not replayable. The untrusted log is log text, not authority, and grants no permission to retry as root or relabel the operation. No edit, proposal, test, action, approval or provider fact was invented.
